variants.suspected_cause: The first candidate mapped A4 offsets with 0x8000, but the measured startup A4 bias is 0x7ffe, shifting every referenced DATA address by two bytes.
variants.controlled_change: Shift every A4-referenced DATA operand back two bytes and express it through the corresponding canonical mechanical offset.

predicted_effect.note: The parent diagnostic had 88 different A4 identities and five unresolved references; the corrected mapping should remove those identity mismatches without changing the payload length.
